summary: Implemented the missing core of tinydb under tinydb/: LRUCache, freeze/FrozenDict, operations, JSONStorage and MemoryStorage read/write, CachingMiddleware read/write/flush/close, TinyDB table management, Table CRUD with the query cache and string-keyed storage, and the Query builder including fragment and is_cacheable. The last full-suite run was c0-test tests -q: 201 passed, 0 failed.
